# 2 Baruch Chapter 42 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**1** And he answered and said to me: These things also I will explain to you.

**2** As for those who were neither righteous nor wicked, but lived in the middle — these are they who were troubled in their lifetime and suffered tribulation, though they did not serve the wicked and did not walk in the paths of the just; and they will be destroyed.

**3** But those who have walked in this world without righteousness and with love of falsehood, and have not remembered the law of the Mighty One — those will be taken in the judgment, and they will have no remembrance at that time.

**4** But as for those who have truly loved the law and have not lived a double life with regard to their wisdom — these are they who will inherit the world that will not pass away.

**5** And those who will be separated by the law from the mixed ones — those will be counted among the righteous.

**6** For the law will be the judge at that time; it will divide the just from the unjust, and place the righteous on the right and the wicked on the left.

**7** This therefore is the answer I have given to your question.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering. The resolution of the mixed-people question: the Law itself is the final judge (v.6). The three categories (clearly righteous, clearly wicked, mixed) receive different outcomes. The right/left division echoes Matt 25:31-46.*
